g.text: IF YOU'RE SO SMART, WHY ARE YOU NOT · FIT / ATHLETIC · PART 5.0 · THE SYNTHESIS
Athleticism is four banks of gauges. The gaps are the map. One year is one turn of the dial.
ZONE 1 — MASTER INSTRUMENT CLUSTER · TARGET ▸ YOU ▸ GAP (men / women)
ENGINE the motor that buys years
the distance between them is the diagnosis.
the gaps are the diagnosis — the spread of what you can't do tells you which lever to pull.
ZONE 2 — ANNUAL BLOCK-CYCLE DIAL · BUILD ONE BANK · HOLD THE REST · SWAP
EACH QUARTER — ONE BANK BUILT, THE REST HELD AT MINIMUM DOSE
builds Engine + Outputs base · 4× Zone 2 · 1 work-cap · daily CARs
builds Chassis · 4× heavy progression · cardio at MIN
builds Engine / ceiling · 4× Z2 + 2× hard intervals · lift at MIN
builds Outputs / integration · jumps · sprints · contrast · RETEST
…then swap. Repeat yearly — the slope keeps climbing for years.
HOLD THE WHOLE PANEL ≈ 3–4 hrs / wk
VO₂ held ≈ 3 × 30 min/wk (intensity, not volume) · strength held ≈ 2 hard sets/muscle @ 0–1 RIR
LONGEVITY — fitness vs all-cause mortality: no upper limit of benefit (Mandsager 2018, n=122,007)
AVAILABILITY — a body that does what you ask changes how you move through the world.
ENGINEERING DIAGNOSTIC INSTRUMENT — FIT SERIES · ATHLETIC 5 / 5
